title: Design System: RF Wiki — Precision Lab

data.purpose: Tabular numeric readouts, units, variables and SCPI.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Only for content that physically floats above the page.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Interruptible trace and control state changes.

narrative.overview: Bright lab documentation and a dark instrument surface share one state. Ornament is removed so alignment, direct labels and numeric truth carry trust.
keyCharacteristics: Signal Spine + Linked Views + Cause/Effect Ledger

rules.name: Physical Meaning
rules.body: Every non-neutral color must name a physical role.

rules.name: Three Cue
rules.body: Critical traces use color, line/marker and a direct label.

rules.name: Flat Bench
rules.body: Resting surfaces are flat; elevation communicates real stacking or interaction.

dos: Do keep control, changed stage, resulting view and interpretation in one visual field.
donts: Don't use beige notes, purple gradients, glassmorphism, marketing heroes, generic card grids or decorative motion.
